vision.concept: Mom discovers a tiny LES concert flyer and prepares for her son’s show as though he is headlining Madison Square Garden.
vision.concept_title: The Biggest Show in the World (According to Mom)
vision.song_meaning: A mother believes in her musician son long before the world does. Inspired by childhood rock shows and current Lower East Side gigs.
vision.visual_style_notes: Deadpan comedy; natural apartment footage with music-video energy
vision.signature_visual: Tiny local-show flyer treated like Times Square billboard; Mom’s THAT’S MY SON sign
vision.ending: Mom and CHXNDLER dance/sing together; her stadium-sized pride contrasts with the small reality.

storyboard.title: The Announcement
storyboard.description: Mom spots CHXNDLER in tiny print on a flyer on the fridge, circles his name, writes SOLD OUT and celebrates; he notices the exaggeration.

storyboard.title: Superfan Training
storyboard.description: Mom wears CHXNDLER merch, makes THAT’S MY SON sign, learns every lyric, practices screaming and dramatically fainting on the couch.

storyboard.title: Private Soundcheck
storyboard.description: CHXNDLER sings while getting ready in bathroom; Mom appears with sign and phone, cheering and demanding an encore.

storyboard.title: Pre-Show Party
storyboard.description: Mom sings and dances to his song in kitchen, grabs CHXNDLER and gets him to join her.

storyboard.title: The Big Show
storyboard.description: Preferred practical version: shoot a real tiny gig if one is scheduled; Mom cheers like an arena. Ultra-low-budget alternative: reveal a one-chair living-room concert.

storyboard.title: After the Show
storyboard.description: Mom takes a celebrity-style selfie with CHXNDLER, hugs him, and continues celebrating.

production.props_notes: CHXNDLER merch, flyer, marker, sign, phone, sunglasses
production.production_notes: Venue vs living-room reveal is NOT finalized; choose one coherent version before shoot.

vision.concept: An unseen first-person protagonist navigates an overwhelming day; midway we discover we have been seeing through a dog’s eyes.
vision.song_meaning: A dog is somebody: they feel fear, shyness, loneliness, joy, love and trust.
vision.visual_style_notes: First-person low camera; natural light; gentle sound design
vision.signature_visual: Mid-song reveal that unseen POV narrator is a dog
vision.ending: Dog looks into camera / human meets their gaze; empathy without text explanation.

storyboard.title: An Ordinary Morning
storyboard.description: First-person camera wakes to light, watches a human prepare breakfast; no dog features revealed.

storyboard.title: The Big World
storyboard.description: POV experiences rushing feet, loud noises, a stranger reaching, uncertainty around others; emotional perspective without obvious canine props.

storyboard.title: The Reveal
storyboard.description: POV approaches CHXNDLER distracted on couch. He looks down, smiles Hey buddy; cut wide for first sight of dog.

storyboard.title: Someone Sees Me
storyboard.description: Now external shots show dog’s natural hesitations, window watching, toy invitation and CHXNDLER choosing to sit at dog’s level.

storyboard.title: I Am Somebody
storyboard.description: Return to dog POV as CHXNDLER looks into lens with affection; no speech necessary.

production.props_notes: Dog toy; camera low to ground
production.production_notes: Dog welfare first: short sessions, no forced actions or startling sounds; edit sound in post.

vision.concept: CHXNDLER falls for an intimidating-looking emo girl who secretly adores cute things and happy dances.
vision.song_meaning: Falling for someone whose dark style does not predict their joyful personality.
vision.signature_visual: All-black deadpan emo girl holding huge pink heart balloon
vision.ending: The girl’s private happy dance reveals she is falling in love too.

storyboard.title: The Crush
storyboard.description: She sits deadpan in black; CHXNDLER sits beside her; she silently sticks a pink heart sticker on his cheek.

storyboard.title: The Secret
storyboard.description: She opens a dark closet to reveal one oversized pink plush, hugs it, then solemnly gives him a tiny plush.

storyboard.title: The Date
storyboard.description: She paints his nails black, he puts a pink clip in her hair; they do an absurdly cheerful dance while she keeps a straight face.

storyboard.title: The Photo
storyboard.description: They pose for an extremely serious emo selfie; immediately afterward they laugh, kiss and dance.

storyboard.title: Secret Happy Dance
storyboard.description: After CHXNDLER walks away holding her pink heart balloon, she breaks into a tiny uncontrollable happy dance.

production.props_notes: Pink heart balloon, heart stickers, plush, black nail polish, hair clip, phone
production.production_notes: MGK cover; obtain composition synchronization permission before public music-video release.

vision.concept: Two lovers follow a treasure map toward a ring but choose the joy of being lost together over reaching a prescribed future.
vision.song_meaning: A cruise to Bermuda, getting lost together, imagining marriage and a ring that never became a wedding; the adventure mattered most.
vision.visual_style_notes: Golden-hour tropical romance, nostalgic vacation-film texture
vision.signature_visual: Treasure map marked X; box with a ring they choose not to take
vision.ending: Missed boat / sunset dance; love was the adventure, not the wedding.

storyboard.title: The Map
storyboard.description: Travel plans reveal a hand-drawn map with an X; couple sets out on treasure hunt.

storyboard.title: Lost Together
storyboard.description: They follow the map, go the wrong way, dance on beach, laugh and take playful pictures; she admires a ring in a shop window if available.

storyboard.title: The Treasure
storyboard.description: They find a small box with a ring; she closes it before a proposal and pulls him back toward the ocean.

storyboard.title: The Boat
storyboard.description: They realize the cruise ship may be leaving; they start to run, then stop to enjoy the sunset together.

storyboard.title: Get Lost With Me
storyboard.description: They dance as the map blows across sand, revealing GET LOST WITH ME.

production.props_notes: Hand-drawn map, small jewelry box, prop ring, travel tickets, beach bag
production.production_notes: Do not imply actual marriage happened; cruise departure can be suggested in editing rather than filming a ship.

vision.concept: A couple performs an entire imaginary domestic life in an empty room, without a single real piece of furniture.
vision.song_meaning: Two lovers play at having a family and a future as though they were children playing house.
vision.signature_visual: Two adults living in a fully invisible house; one real key
vision.ending: Overhead wide shot reveals empty room, couple together and a single real key.

storyboard.title: Welcome Home
storyboard.description: He turns a real key in an invisible door; she knocks and enters their imagined house.

storyboard.title: Our Little Life
storyboard.description: They mime cooking, eating at an invisible table, bringing groceries and dancing in the living room.

storyboard.title: Our Future
storyboard.description: They pretend to cradle a baby and laugh when CHXNDLER is nervous holding it.

storyboard.title: Home
storyboard.description: They turn off an invisible light and lie together on the bare floor, embracing.

production.production_notes: Correct title is two words: PLAY HOUSE.

vision.concept: A young couple believe they are living a cinematic love story until the set lights go out and reveal how little they know.
vision.song_meaning: At seventeen, learning romance from TV and movies does not mean knowing how to love.
vision.signature_visual: Romantic couch scene revealed as a fake movie set
vision.ending: CHXNDLER alone under last TV glow; THE END.

storyboard.title: The Movie
storyboard.description: Couple watch romance on a couch; camera pulls back to show it is a set in an otherwise empty room.

storyboard.title: Movie Romance
storyboard.description: On the couch they share cheap red roses, a burned CD and headphones, copying film-like romantic moments.

storyboard.title: The Exit
storyboard.description: She walks away; CHXNDLER waits as studio lights turn off one by one.

storyboard.title: The End
storyboard.description: He sits alone while television replays happy moments and shows THE END.

production.props_notes: Couch, old TV, red roses, burned CD, film lights
production.production_notes: Lil Wayne composition; video sync clearance required.

vision.concept: CHXNDLER’s world tilts when he falls for a girl; simple camera rotations make him appear to defy gravity.
vision.song_meaning: Love makes gravity and emotional balance disappear.
vision.signature_visual: Apparent sideways wall-walk achieved by rotating camera
vision.ending: She exits; his gravity never returns to normal.

storyboard.title: Gravity Shifts

storyboard.title: Sideways
storyboard.description: As she walks away, the room seems to tip further and he loses his bearings.

storyboard.title: Aftermath
storyboard.description: Normal view returns; a safe floor-camera trick makes him appear stuck on the ceiling.

production.props_notes: Picture frame, cup, simple safe camera rig

vision.signature_visual: Friends making a human wave against the NYC skyline
vision.ending: CHXNDLER looks out at city he once dreamed of.

vision.concept: A silver clay alien is squeezed into a human-shaped NORMAL mold until he breaks free and reshapes gray NYC into a colorful Heartverse.
vision.song_meaning: Other people try to shape an artist into someone acceptable; refusing conformity gives him the power to reshape his world.
vision.signature_visual: Silver alien crushed into NORMAL-shaped mold
vision.ending: Gray NYC becomes bright Heartverse; alien makes another unique friend.

storyboard.title: Assembly Line

storyboard.title: Breakout

storyboard.title: Another Mold
storyboard.description: Even creative peers pressure him to become someone else; he peels off false identity.

storyboard.title: Reshape
storyboard.description: He transforms gray buildings into bright clay life and makes room for different creatures.
